res.mass.why.en: Everything you add must fit on the rocket. Structure and wiring make up about 22% of the dry mass (about 28% on top of the parts), and propellant comes on top of that. OCO weighed 441 kg; its Taurus XL could lift 1,350 kg to low orbit.
res.mass.why.zh-TW: 加上去的東西都要塞得進火箭。結構與線材約佔乾重的 22%（等於在零件之外再多約 28%），推進劑另外算。OCO 重 441 公斤，金牛座 XL 能把 1,350 公斤送到低軌道。

res.power.why.en: In the Earth's shadow the battery runs everything, and in sunlight the panels must both run the satellite and recharge it, so the array has to be much bigger than the load. Panels also lose ~2.75% a year.
res.power.why.zh-TW: 在地球影子裡全靠電池供電；在陽光下太陽能板要同時供電又充電，所以面積要比負載大很多。太陽能板每年還會衰退約 2.75%。

res.budget.why.en: Development + launch + operations every year. Real missions keep a reserve because surprises always cost money.
res.budget.why.zh-TW: 開發費 + 發射費 + 每年營運費。真實任務都會保留準備金，因為意外一定會花錢。

res.data.why.en: Data is what the instruments produce. Between ground-station passes it waits in the onboard recorder; if the recorder fills before the next pass, new data is lost.
res.data.why.zh-TW: 資料就是儀器產生的觀測結果。兩次過境之間，資料都存在衛星上的記錄器；下次過境前存滿了，新資料就會遺失。

res.comms.why.en: Communications bring the data home. Each pass over a ground station lasts only 5-12 minutes: rate × minutes per day must keep up with what the instruments collect. OCO needed just 6.75 minutes a day at 150 Mbit/s.
res.comms.why.zh-TW: 通訊負責把資料傳回地面。每次飛過地面站只有 5–12 分鐘：速率 × 每天通聯分鐘數要跟得上儀器產生的資料量。OCO 每天只需要以 150 Mbit/s 傳 6.75 分鐘。

warn.mass.en: {over:0} kg over what the {launcher} can lift to this orbit.
warn.mass.zh-TW: 超過{launcher}到這個軌道的運力 {over:0} 公斤。

warn.orbit_unreachable.en: This rocket cannot reach the chosen orbit.
warn.orbit_unreachable.zh-TW: 這支火箭到不了選擇的軌道。

warn.power.en: Power short by {short_w:0} W at end of mission: the panels cannot run the load and recharge the battery.
warn.power.zh-TW: 任務末期電力不足 {short_w:0} W：太陽能板撐不起負載又要充電。

warn.battery.en: Battery too small: {short_wh:0} Wh short for the {eclipse_min:0}-minute shadow at a safe depth of discharge.
warn.battery.zh-TW: 電池太小：要在安全放電深度下撐過 {eclipse_min:0} 分鐘的影子，還差 {short_wh:0} Wh。

warn.budget.zh-TW: 超出預算 {over:0.0} 百萬美元。

warn.storage.en: Recorder too small: {raw:0.0} GB piles up between passes but only {capacity:0} GB is fitted, so data will be lost. Data returned now: {return_pct:0}%.
warn.storage.zh-TW: 記錄器容量不足：兩次過境之間會累積 {raw:0.0} GB，只裝了 {capacity:0} GB，一定會掉資料。目前能傳回 {return_pct:0}% 的資料。

warn.storage_tight.en: No data storage margin: {raw:0.0} GB piles up between passes and {capacity:0} GB is fitted, below the {used:0.0} GB recommended with a 50% margin. One missed pass or a computer fault will lose data.
warn.storage_tight.zh-TW: 資料儲存沒有安全餘裕：兩次過境之間會累積 {raw:0.0} GB，裝了 {capacity:0} GB，低於含 50% 漏接餘裕的建議值 {used:0.0} GB。漏接一次過境或電腦故障就會掉資料。

warn.downlink.en: Communications cannot keep up: {lost_pct:0}% of the data would be lost.
warn.downlink.zh-TW: 通訊跟不上：下傳速率不夠，會遺失 {lost_pct:0}% 的資料。

warn.lifetime.propellant.zh-TW: 推進劑 {years:0.0} 年就用完（目標 {target:0} 年）。

warn.lifetime.battery.en: The battery wears out after {years:0.0} years of shadow cycles (target {target:0}).
warn.lifetime.battery.zh-TW: 電池經過 {years:0.0} 年的影子充放電就耗損了（目標 {target:0} 年）。

warn.lifetime.radiation.en: Radiation kills the computer after {years:0.0} years (target {target:0}).
warn.lifetime.radiation.zh-TW: 輻射會在 {years:0.0} 年後毀掉電腦（目標 {target:0} 年）。

warn.instrument_mismatch.en: This instrument doesn't help this mission.
warn.instrument_mismatch.zh-TW: 這台儀器對這次任務沒用。

warn.too_many_instruments.en: Too many instruments for this bus.
warn.too_many_instruments.zh-TW: 儀器太多，這個平台裝不下。

launch.lower_orbit.en: Insertion into a lower orbit: the rocket had almost no margin left.
launch.lower_orbit.zh-TW: 進入較低的軌道：火箭幾乎沒有剩餘運力。

launch.anomaly.en: Launch vehicle anomaly. The spacecraft was lost.
launch.anomaly.zh-TW: 火箭發生異常，太空船損失。

launch.overweight.en: Too heavy: the rocket could not reach orbital velocity.
launch.overweight.zh-TW: 太重了：火箭達不到入軌速度。

launch.unreachable.en: This rocket cannot reach that orbit.
launch.unreachable.zh-TW: 這支火箭到不了那個軌道。

launch.fairing.en: The payload fairing did not separate. Carrying its extra mass, the rocket fell short of orbit.
launch.fairing.zh-TW: 酬載整流罩沒有分離。多背著這些重量，火箭到不了軌道。

event.storm.safe.en: Procedure complete: the spacecraft rode out the storm in safe mode.
event.storm.safe.zh-TW: 處置完成：太空船在安全模式下撐過風暴。

event.storm.ok.en: The storm passed without damage, but the procedure was not finished.
event.storm.ok.zh-TW: 風暴過去了，沒有損壞，但處置沒有做完。

event.failure.redundant.en: The backup took over automatically. No impact.
event.failure.redundant.zh-TW: 備援自動接手，沒有影響。

event.failure.computer.en: Half of the recorder is gone: storage cut to 50%.
event.failure.computer.zh-TW: 記錄器壞了一半：儲存容量剩 50%。

event.failure.adcs.en: Pointing is degraded: every instrument loses 25%.
event.failure.adcs.zh-TW: 指向精度變差：每台儀器少 25% 產出。

event.failure.antenna.en: The transmitter is degraded: downlink halved.
event.failure.antenna.zh-TW: 發射機降級：下傳速度減半。

event.opportunity.strained.en: Captured it, but the power system was strained: half the bonus and extra battery wear.
event.opportunity.strained.zh-TW: 拍到了，但電力吃緊：只有一半加分，電池也多耗損了。

cause.mass_total.en: Launch mass {wet} kg vs. {launcher}'s {cap} kg to this orbit.
cause.mass_total.zh-TW: 發射質量 {wet} 公斤，{launcher}到這個軌道只能載 {cap} 公斤。

cause.launch_overweight.en: Overweight: the rocket could not reach orbital speed.
cause.launch_overweight.zh-TW: 超重：火箭達不到入軌速度。

cause.launch_anomaly.en: This flight was one of the failures.
cause.launch_anomaly.zh-TW: 這次剛好是失敗的那一次。

cause.fairing_mass.en: The extra mass left it ~300 m/s short of orbital velocity.
cause.fairing_mass.zh-TW: 多出的重量讓它差了約每秒 300 公尺的入軌速度。

cause.lower_orbit.en: The rocket ran out of performance and left us in a lower orbit.
cause.lower_orbit.zh-TW: 火箭推力用盡，把衛星留在較低的軌道。

cause.drag_doubled.en: Thicker air doubled the drag; the mission lasted {years} years.
cause.drag_doubled.zh-TW: 大氣較濃，阻力加倍；任務撐了 {years} 年。

cause.data_generated.en: {part} and the other instruments produce {gb} GB a day.

cause.storage_capacity.zh-TW: {part}在兩次過境之間只能存 {gb} GB。

cause.downlink_capacity.en: {part} with {stations} station(s) can send {gb} GB a day.
cause.downlink_capacity.zh-TW: {part}配 {stations} 座地面站，每天只能傳 {gb} GB。

cause.data_lost.en: {pct}% of the data never came home.

cause.power_load.en: The load needs {w} W from the array.
cause.power_load.zh-TW: 負載需要太陽能板提供 {w} W。

cause.array_eol.en: After {years} years the panels deliver only {w} W.
cause.array_eol.zh-TW: {years} 年後太陽能板只剩 {w} W。

cause.duty.en: Instruments ran only {pct}% of the time.
cause.duty.zh-TW: 儀器只有 {pct}% 的時間在運作。

cause.funding_left.en: After development and the rocket, {left} M$ was left for operations ({per} M$ a year).
cause.funding_left.zh-TW: 扣掉開發費和火箭，營運經費只剩 {left} M$（每年要 {per} M$）。

cause.funding_out.en: The operations money ran out after {years} years and the mission ended early.
cause.funding_out.zh-TW: 營運經費在 {years} 年後用完，任務提前結束。

cause.ended_early.en: The mission ended after {years} of {target} years.
cause.ended_early.zh-TW: 任務在第 {years} 年結束（目標 {target} 年）。

cause.orbit_drag.en: {orbit} needs {dv} m/s a year to fight drag.
cause.orbit_drag.zh-TW: {orbit}每年需要 {dv} m/s 對抗阻力。

cause.eclipses.en: {n} shadow passes a year, each draining the battery to {dod}%.
cause.eclipses.zh-TW: 每年進出影子 {n} 次，每次電池放電到 {dod}%。

cause.kept_running.en: The storm procedure was not finished.
cause.kept_running.zh-TW: 太陽風暴的處置沒有做完。

cause.degraded.en: The rest of the mission ran degraded.
cause.degraded.zh-TW: 剩下的任務都降級運作。

cause.success_return.en: {pct}% of the data made it home.

suggest.launcher_reach.en: Pick a rocket that can reach your orbit (check the capacity table).
suggest.launcher_reach.zh-TW: 選一支到得了你的軌道的火箭（看運力表）。

suggest.mass.en: Lighten the spacecraft or move up to a bigger rocket.
suggest.mass.zh-TW: 減輕太空船，或換更大的火箭。

suggest.history_launcher.en: Try a different rocket. That is what NASA did.
suggest.history_launcher.zh-TW: 換一支火箭試試。NASA 當年就是這麼做的。

suggest.mass_margin.en: Leave at least 5% of the rocket's capacity unused.
suggest.mass_margin.zh-TW: 火箭運力至少留 5% 不要用滿。

suggest.downlink.en: Add ground stations or a faster antenna, or carry fewer data-hungry instruments.
suggest.downlink.zh-TW: 增加地面站或換更快的天線，或少帶資料量大的儀器。

suggest.storage.en: A bigger recorder, or more ground stations so it empties more often.
suggest.storage.zh-TW: 換更大的記錄器，或增加地面站讓它更常清空。

suggest.power.en: Bigger panels, or drop the most power-hungry instrument.
suggest.power.zh-TW: 加大太陽能板，或拿掉最耗電的儀器。

suggest.propellant.en: Carry more propellant, or fly higher where drag is weaker.
suggest.propellant.zh-TW: 多帶推進劑，或飛高一點讓阻力變小。

suggest.battery.en: A bigger battery discharges less deeply each orbit and lasts many more cycles.
suggest.battery.zh-TW: 電池加大，每圈放電較淺，循環壽命會長很多。

suggest.shielding.en: Thicker shielding or a radiation-hardened computer.
suggest.shielding.zh-TW: 加厚屏蔽，或換抗輻射電腦。

suggest.redundancy.en: Redundant parts (spare wheels, dual computers) turn a failure into a non-event.
suggest.redundancy.zh-TW: 備援零件（備用反應輪、雙電腦）能讓故障變成小事。

cause.science_low.zh-TW: 科學分 {score} 分，任務需求 {need} 分。

cause.grade_capped.en: The mission missed its purpose, so the grade is capped at C however good the rest was.
cause.grade_capped.zh-TW: 任務目的沒達成，其他分項再好，評等最高也只有 C。

cause.science_fail.en: That is less than half: the mission returned too little to count, so it is graded FAIL.
cause.science_fail.zh-TW: 不到要求的一半：成果少到不算數，判定任務失敗。

suggest.science_low.en: Not enough science: pick instruments and an orbit that fit the mission, and make sure the data gets home.
suggest.science_low.zh-TW: 科學分不夠：換更契合任務的儀器和軌道，並確認資料傳得回來。

suggest.more_science.en: You had money to spare: try a more capable instrument.
suggest.more_science.zh-TW: 預算還有剩：試試更強的儀器。

launch.dead_on_orbit.en: The spacecraft reached orbit and deployed, then lost power in its first pass through Earth's shadow.
launch.dead_on_orbit.zh-TW: 太空船順利入軌、展開，卻在第一次進入地影時斷電失聯。

cause.eclipse_need.zh-TW: 每次 {min} 分鐘的地影需要大約 {need} Wh。

cause.dead_on_orbit.en: The battery ran flat in the first shadow and the spacecraft went silent.
cause.dead_on_orbit.zh-TW: 電池在第一次地影就用光，衛星失聯。

cause.power_anomaly.en: A power anomaly drained the battery.
cause.power_anomaly.zh-TW: 電量異常讓電池快速放電。

cause.not_handled.en: Only {done} of {total} procedure steps were done.
cause.not_handled.zh-TW: 處置手冊的 {total} 個步驟只做了 {done} 個。

suggest.battery_eclipse.en: Look up the shadow length in the manual's quick tables, then pick a battery that lasts through it.
suggest.battery_eclipse.zh-TW: 地影有多長，查手冊的快查表，再選撐得過的電池。

suggest.power_procedure.en: When the battery drops fast with normal radiation, run the power-anomaly procedure.
suggest.power_procedure.zh-TW: 電量掉得快、輻射卻正常時，照電量異常的處置手冊操作。

suggest.storm_procedure.en: When radiation spikes, shut the instruments, go to safe mode and point at the Sun.
suggest.storm_procedure.zh-TW: 輻射暴增時，關閉儀器、切換安全模式、太陽能板對日。

event.power.handled.en: Procedure complete: load shed and battery protected.
event.power.handled.zh-TW: 處置完成：降低負載，電池受到保護。

event.power.drained.en: The battery was drained deeply and lost part of its life.
event.power.drained.zh-TW: 電池被深度放電，壽命減少。

event.failure.instrument_contained.en: The failed instrument was isolated and partly recovered.
event.failure.instrument_contained.zh-TW: 故障的儀器被隔離，部分功能恢復。

event.failure.computer_contained.en: The computer was rebooted on backup; most storage recovered.
event.failure.computer_contained.zh-TW: 電腦切換備援重新開機，大部分儲存空間恢復。

event.failure.adcs_contained.en: Attitude control was reset; pointing mostly recovered.
event.failure.adcs_contained.zh-TW: 姿態控制重新設定，指向大致恢復。

event.failure.antenna_contained.en: The radio was switched to backup mode; most of the downlink recovered.
event.failure.antenna_contained.zh-TW: 通訊切換到備援模式，大部分下傳速率恢復。

event.diag.solar_storm.en: Radiation dose rate and proton flux jump; solar array output dips a little. Compare with past DONKI storm records.
event.diag.solar_storm.zh-TW: 輻射劑量率和質子通量暴增，太陽能板輸出略降。可以對照 DONKI 過去的太陽風暴紀錄。

event.diag.part_failure.en: One part reads FAULT, NO SIGNAL, ERR or DEGRADED while everything else looks normal.
event.diag.part_failure.zh-TW: 某個零件的讀數顯示 FAULT、NO SIGNAL、ERR 或 DEGRADED，其他都正常。

event.diag.science_opportunity.en: The payload console shows a ground alert (wildfire, volcano, flood or hurricane). All other readings are normal.
event.diag.science_opportunity.zh-TW: 酬載台出現地面通報（野火、火山、洪水或颶風），其他讀數都正常。

event.diag.power_anomaly.en: Battery charge falls fast and solar output halves, but radiation is normal.
event.diag.power_anomaly.zh-TW: 電池電量快速下降、太陽能板輸出掉到一半，但輻射正常。

objective.earth_observation.en: watching Earth's land: crops, fires and water
objective.earth_observation.zh-TW: 觀測地表：農作物、火災和水資源

objective.lunar_mapping.en: mapping the Moon's surface and minerals

objective.carbon_monitoring.en: measuring carbon dioxide in the air around the world
objective.carbon_monitoring.zh-TW: 量測全球大氣中的二氧化碳

err.locked.en: This is the original 2009 design: launch it first to see what happened.
err.locked.zh-TW: 這是 2009 年的原始設計：先發射，看看當年發生了什麼。

err.not_allowed.en: That option isn't available for this mission.

err.hands_full.en: Your hands are full. Use what you carry, or press C to put it back.
err.hands_full.zh-TW: 手上拿滿了。先拿去用，或按 C 放回。

err.taken.en: Someone else is holding that part.

err.instruments_full.en: No room for another instrument. Untick one first.
err.instruments_full.zh-TW: 儀器已經選滿了，先取消一台。

ui.title.eyebrow.zh-TW: NASA SPACE APPS · 衛星任務設計

ui.title.tagline.zh-TW: 拿 NASA 的真實資料，和隊友找線索、挑零件、組衛星、發射，再到中控室處理突發狀況。

ui.history.you_rewrote.zh-TW: 歷史改寫了：衛星進入軌道。

ui.history.still_failed.zh-TW: 歷史重演了。再看一次火箭。

ui.launch.call.pitch.en: Vehicle has started its pitch and roll program.
ui.launch.call.pitch.zh-TW: 火箭開始俯仰與滾轉程序。

ui.launch.call.fairing_fail.zh-TW: 沒有整流罩分離的訊號……

ui.launch.call.underspeed.zh-TW: 速度不足，無法進入軌道。

ui.launch.call.anomaly.zh-TW: 遙測中斷，飛控人員正在評估。

ui.launch.call.orbit.en: Engine cutoff. We are in orbit.

ui.launch.call.lower.en: Insertion is lower than planned, but we are in orbit.
ui.launch.call.lower.zh-TW: 入軌高度比預期低，但已進入軌道。

ui.launch.call.deploy.zh-TW: 衛星分離，太陽能板展開中。

ui.report.grade.s.en: Outstanding. NASA would want to hire you.
ui.report.grade.s.zh-TW: 傑出。NASA 看了會想挖角。

ui.report.grade.b.zh-TW: 穩穩過關，還有地方能改。

ui.report.grade.fail.zh-TW: 任務失敗。看看哪一條需求沒達成，再試一次。

ui.fac.failures_body.zh-TW: 之前的發射為什麼失敗。

ui.fac.ops_desk_body.en: Call what happened and end the turn.

ui.fac.ops_console_body.en: Telemetry and commands for this subsystem.
ui.fac.ops_console_body.zh-TW: 這個子系統的遙測與指令。

ui.fac.launch_body.en: Launch the satellite on the integration stand.

ui.fac.lobby_body.en: Room code, settings and who's ready.
ui.fac.lobby_body.zh-TW: 房間碼、設定、誰準備好了。

ui.brief.op.zh-TW: 加密通訊 · 任務指令

ui.brief.speaker.title.zh-TW: 任務控制中心飛行主任

ui.brief.todo_solo.en: Pick parts on the [[design board]] up front. Blank values are in [[clues]] around [[both rooms]]: walls, boards, books, desks, lockers, even the floor.
ui.brief.todo_solo.zh-TW: 到前面的[[設計主螢幕]]選零件。空白的數值要從[[線索]]找，線索在[[兩個房間]]的牆上、板子、書、桌面、櫃子，地上也有。

ui.brief.todo_history.en: Press launch and watch what happened in [[2009]]. Then the design unlocks and it is your turn to [[change history]].
ui.brief.todo_history.zh-TW: 按下發射，看 [[2009 年]]發生了什麼。之後設計會解鎖，換你[[改寫歷史]]。

ui.brief.close_history.en: Countdown's running. Watch closely: this is what happened in 2009.
ui.brief.close_history.zh-TW: 倒數開始了。看好，接下來就是 2009 年那天發生的事。

ui.brief.close_solo.en: Requirements are on the [[design board]]. Find the values, pick the parts, confirm the design, then build it in the bay. Off you go.
ui.brief.close_solo.zh-TW: 需求在[[設計主螢幕]]上。數值找齊、零件選好、確定設計，然後去組裝區組起來。去吧。

ui.brief.speech.default.en:
Chou, flight director.
We've got a new spacecraft to [[design and launch]], and it's yours.
ui.brief.speech.default.zh-TW:
我是周以安，飛行主任。
有一艘新的太空船要[[設計並發射]]，交給你們了。

ui.brief.speech.earth_observation.en:
Chou, flight director.
Fire season starts earlier every year, floods are harder to call, and our crop data is stale.
I need an [[Earth-observation satellite]] designed and launched to keep an eye on [[wildfires, floods and farmland]].
ui.brief.speech.earth_observation.zh-TW:
我是周以安，飛行主任。
野火一年比一年早，洪水越來越難抓，農田資料也舊了。
要請你們設計並發射一顆[[對地觀測衛星]]，盯住[[野火、洪水和農田]]。

ui.brief.speech.lunar_mapping.en:
Chou, flight director.
The next landers need to pick their sites, and our Moon maps aren't detailed enough.
Put a spacecraft in [[lunar orbit]] and [[map the whole surface]]. Fair warning: the Moon is far, data is hard to get home, and everything costs more.
ui.brief.speech.lunar_mapping.zh-TW:
我是周以安，飛行主任。
下一批登月任務要選降落點，可是現有的月面地圖不夠細。
把太空船送進[[月球軌道]]，[[測繪整個月面]]。先講好，月球很遠，資料難傳，什麼都比較貴。

ui.brief.speech.hist_oco.en:
It's [[2009]]. Chou here.
NASA's first satellite built just to measure carbon dioxide, [[OCO]], is on the pad.
The design is locked. [[It flies today, exactly as built.]]
ui.brief.speech.hist_oco.zh-TW:
現在是 [[2009 年]]，我是周以安。
NASA 第一顆專門量二氧化碳的衛星 [[OCO]] 已經在發射場待命。
設計定案了，[[今天照原樣發射]]。

ui.dash.colors_off.en: No colour hints at this difficulty: read the numbers.
ui.dash.colors_off.zh-TW: 這個難度沒有顏色提示：自己看數字。

ui.manual.rule.power.en: Solar array output in sunlight must cover every part's power, plus recharging the battery for the next eclipse.
ui.manual.rule.power.zh-TW: 日照時太陽能板的輸出要供應所有零件，還要替下一次地影把電池充回來。

ui.manual.rule.battery.en: In eclipse everything runs on the battery. Draining it too deep each orbit wears it out; draining it past 100% kills the spacecraft.
ui.manual.rule.battery.zh-TW: 地影期間全靠電池。每圈放電太深會耗損電池；超過 100% 太空船就會斷電。

ui.manual.rule.mass.en: The launcher can only lift so much to your orbit. Over the limit, it reaches a lower orbit or none at all.
ui.manual.rule.mass.zh-TW: 火箭送到你的軌道有重量上限。超過的話只能到較低的軌道，甚至到不了。

ui.manual.rule.data.en: Instruments make data; antennas and ground stations bring it down. Data that cannot be downlinked is lost.
ui.manual.rule.data.zh-TW: 儀器產生資料，天線和地面站把它傳回來。傳不下來的資料就沒了。

ui.manual.rule.comms.en: Far orbits need a stronger antenna. Some ground stations cannot reach some orbits.
ui.manual.rule.comms.zh-TW: 遠的軌道需要更強的天線。有些地面站收不到某些軌道。

ui.manual.rule.budget.en: Parts, launcher and years of operations all cost money. Over budget, you cannot launch.
ui.manual.rule.budget.zh-TW: 零件、火箭和營運年數都要花錢。超出預算就不能發射。

ui.manual.rule.lifetime.en: The mission lasts until propellant runs out, the battery wears out or radiation kills the electronics.
ui.manual.rule.lifetime.zh-TW: 任務會持續到推進劑用完、電池耗盡或電子元件被輻射破壞為止。

ui.manual.rule.instruments.en: Each scenario allows a limited number of instruments. More instruments mean more science but more power and data.
ui.manual.rule.instruments.zh-TW: 每個任務的儀器數量有上限。儀器越多，科學分越高，但也更耗電、資料量更大。

ui.manual.conflicts_body.en: Send both in the same turn and neither takes effect.
ui.manual.conflicts_body.zh-TW: 同一回合兩個都送出，兩個都不會生效。

ui.manual.ch.rules_body.en: What each number has to satisfy, plus look-up tables.
ui.manual.ch.rules_body.zh-TW: 每個數字要滿足什麼，加上快查表。

ui.manual.ch.diagnose_body.en: Symptom table: which event is happening.
ui.manual.ch.diagnose_body.zh-TW: 症狀對照表：判斷發生了哪種事件。

ui.manual.ch.procedures_body.en: The steps to take for each event.
ui.manual.ch.procedures_body.zh-TW: 每種事件要做的處置步驟。

ui.manual.ch.donki_body.en: Real solar storms from NASA's DONKI database and NOAA SWPC.
ui.manual.ch.donki_body.zh-TW: NASA DONKI 資料庫與 NOAA SWPC 的真實太陽風暴。

ui.manual.intro.rules.en: How each number on the design board dashboard is judged. Use the look-up tables before you choose.
ui.manual.intro.rules.zh-TW: 設計主螢幕儀表板上每個數字怎麼判定。選件前先用快查表試算。

ui.manual.intro.diagnose.en: The system never names the event. Match the ops console readings to a row, then turn to Manual 3.
ui.manual.intro.diagnose.zh-TW: 系統不會直接說是哪種事件。對照營運台的讀數找出相符的一列，再翻手冊 3。

ui.manual.intro.procedures.en: Do the steps in order. The treatment minigame is these same steps.
ui.manual.intro.procedures.zh-TW: 照順序做。處置小遊戲就是這幾步。

ui.manual.intro.donki.en: Real storms logged by NASA DONKI and NOAA SWPC. The strongest ones often bring a radiation spike; compare today's dose.
ui.manual.intro.donki.zh-TW: NASA DONKI 與 NOAA SWPC 記錄的真實風暴。最強的幾次常伴隨輻射暴增，可以拿目前的劑量來比。

ui.manual.matrix_hint.en: — = normal. Readings come from the four ops consoles.
ui.manual.matrix_hint.zh-TW: — = 正常。讀數來自四台營運控制台。

ui.manual.consoles_at.en: Ops consoles (the green desks either side of the flight director):
ui.manual.consoles_at.zh-TW: 營運控制台（飛行總監台兩側的綠色席位）：

ui.manual.timeline_hint.en: Bar height = severity (1–3). Worst first from the next page.
ui.manual.timeline_hint.zh-TW: 長條高度＝強度（1–3）。下一頁起由強到弱。

ui.launchp.question.en: Launch the satellite on the stand?

ui.launchp.body.en: The rocket takes what is on the integration stand right now.
ui.launchp.body.zh-TW: 火箭帶走的是整合台上現在的樣子。

ui.fail.none.en: No failed launches. Keep it that way.

ui.fail.category.power.en: Power: the spacecraft died in its first eclipse.
ui.fail.category.power.zh-TW: 電力：太空船在第一次地影就斷電了。

ui.fail.category.launcher.zh-TW: 火箭：是火箭本身出了狀況。

ui.fail.category.mass.en: Mass: too heavy for this rocket and orbit.
ui.fail.category.mass.zh-TW: 質量：對這枚火箭和軌道來說太重。

ui.ops.judge_hint.en: Compare the console readings with the manual's diagnosis page.
ui.ops.judge_hint.zh-TW: 把控制台的讀數和手冊的判讀頁對照。

ui.ops.act_hint.en: Send commands from the four consoles, in order. Each extra command costs ops points, and some cancel each other out (see the manual).
ui.ops.act_hint.zh-TW: 到四台控制台依序送指令。多送一個沒用的指令就扣營運分，有些指令會互相抵銷（見手冊）。

ui.ops.conflicted.en: Cancelled each other out, no effect: {list}

ui.ops.wrong.zh-TW: 多餘的處置：{list}（這回合營運分 −{pts}）

ui.ops.console_idle.en: Nominal. Come back when something happens.

ui.ops.irreversible.en: Commands cannot be undone this turn.
ui.ops.irreversible.zh-TW: 這回合送出的指令不能收回。

ui.lobby.ip.en: Same network · players join with this IP
ui.lobby.ip.zh-TW: 同一個網路 · 其他人用這個 IP 加入

ui.net.err.cloud.en: Room codes need Unity Cloud linked. Use the same-network option below for now.
ui.net.err.cloud.zh-TW: 房間碼要先把遊戲連上 Unity Cloud。先改用下面的「同一個網路」。

ui.net.err.create.en: Couldn't create a room. Check your connection and try again.
ui.net.err.create.zh-TW: 開不了房間。檢查網路後再試一次。

ui.net.err.connect.en: Could not connect to the host.

ui.net.err.port.en: Could not open port 7777 on this computer.
ui.net.err.port.zh-TW: 這台電腦無法開啟 7777 埠。

ui.net.err.ip.en: That is not an IP address (like 192.168.1.20).

ui.net.err.web_host.en: A browser cannot host by IP. Use a room code instead.
ui.net.err.web_host.zh-TW: 瀏覽器不能用 IP 當房主，請改用房間碼。

ui.launch.call.eclipse.en: Entering Earth's shadow. Running on battery.
ui.launch.call.eclipse.zh-TW: 進入地球陰影，改用電池供電。

ui.launch.call.signal_lost.en: We've lost the spacecraft. Battery is empty.
ui.launch.call.signal_lost.zh-TW: 失去太空船訊號，電池耗盡。

ui.launch.redesign_note.en: Back to the facility. The reason is on the failure board.
ui.launch.redesign_note.zh-TW: 回設施重新設計，原因在失敗原因看板上。

ui.launch.restart_note.en: Back to part selection: the design and the satellite return to the start. Filled-in values and the builds you have learned are kept. The reason is on the failure board.
ui.launch.restart_note.zh-TW: 回到選件重來：設計和衛星回到開局。填過的數值、學會的組裝會留著，失敗原因寫在看板上。

ui.report.first_launch.en: Reached orbit on the first launch: bonus
ui.report.first_launch.zh-TW: 第一次發射就成功：加分

ui.tut.move.en: Click the screen first. [[WASD]] to walk, [[Shift]] to run, move the mouse to look around.
ui.tut.move.zh-TW: 先點一下畫面。[[WASD]] 走路、[[Shift]] 跑步，移動滑鼠看四周。

ui.tut.view.en: Press [[Q]] to switch between first person and third person.
ui.tut.view.zh-TW: 按 [[Q]] 切換第一人稱和第三人稱。

ui.tut.install.en: Pick the finished part up at the bench with [[C]], carry it to the [[integration stand]] in the middle and [[hold V]] until the ring fills.
ui.tut.install.zh-TW: 在組裝台按 [[C]] 拿起成品，帶到中間的[[整合台]]旁，[[長按 V]] 直到光環填滿。

ui.tut.launch.en: Go back to the [[control room]], press [[E]] at the [[red launch button]] and confirm. Training launches always work; in a real mission a failed launch sends you back to part selection.
ui.tut.launch.zh-TW: 回[[中控室]]，到[[紅色發射按鈕]]按 [[E]] 並確認。訓練一定成功；正式任務發射失敗的話，要回到選件重來。

ui.tut.console.en: Something went wrong in orbit. Read the warnings on the four green [[ops consoles]], then open POWER. The symptom table is in [[Manual 2]], on the shelf above the book desk.
ui.tut.console.zh-TW: 軌道上出事了。到四台綠色的[[營運控制台]]看警示，打開「電力」看讀數。症狀對照表在書桌上方書架的[[手冊 2]]。

ui.tut.judge.en: At the [[flight director desk]], pick what happened, then pass the treatment game. The steps are in [[Manual 3]].
ui.tut.judge.zh-TW: 到[[飛行總監台]]選出發生了什麼事，再通過處置小遊戲。步驟在[[手冊 3]]。

ui.tut.done.en: That's all of it. NASA matures a mission through [[Concept Maturity Levels]]: sketch → feasibility → trade space → point design. What you just built is a [[point design]]. Pick a real mission from the main menu.
ui.tut.done.zh-TW: 流程就這些。NASA 用[[概念成熟度（CML）]]分階段把任務想清楚：草圖 → 可行性 → 取捨 → 點設計。你剛做出來的就是[[點設計]]。接下來回主選單挑個正式任務。

ui.guide.pick.en: Still to pick: [[{list}]]. Choose one per category on the [[design board]].
ui.guide.pick.zh-TW: 還沒選：[[{list}]]。到[[設計主螢幕]]每一類選一個。

ui.guide.install.en: Carry the part to the [[integration stand]] and [[hold V]].
ui.guide.install.zh-TW: 把零件拿到[[整合台]]，[[長按 V]] 裝上去。

ui.guide.fix.en: Over the limit: [[{list}]]. See by how much on the design board dashboard, then swap parts.
ui.guide.fix.zh-TW: 超出了：[[{list}]]。看設計主螢幕的儀表板差多少，再換零件。

ui.guide.fix_goals.en: Not met yet: [[{list}]]. The Requirements tab on the design board shows how far off each one is.
ui.guide.fix_goals.zh-TW: 還沒達成：[[{list}]]。到設計主螢幕的「任務需求」看每一條差多少。

ui.guide.launch.en: Every part is installed. Press [[launch]] in the control room.
ui.guide.launch.zh-TW: 零件都裝上衛星了。到中控室按[[發射]]。

ui.guide.vote.en: Launch poll open. Press G for GO, N for NO-GO.
ui.guide.vote.zh-TW: 發射點名中。按 G 喊 GO，按 N 喊 NO-GO。

ui.guide.ops_act.en: Something happened in orbit. Read the green ops consoles and send a command from the right one.
ui.guide.ops_act.zh-TW: 軌道上出事了。看四台綠色營運控制台的警示，從對應的控制台送出指令。

ui.guide.ops_end.en: Command sent. End the turn at the flight director desk.
ui.guide.ops_end.zh-TW: 指令送出了。到飛行總監台結束這回合。

ui.guide.ops_next.en: See the result at the flight director desk, then move on to the next turn.
ui.guide.ops_next.zh-TW: 到飛行總監台看結果，再進下一回合。

ui.gmenu.hint_mp.en: Co-op doesn't pause. Everyone else keeps playing.
ui.gmenu.hint_mp.zh-TW: 多人模式不會暫停，其他人還在玩。

ui.gmenu.vol.note.en: Master volume also covers the launch sounds. It does not change voice chat.
ui.gmenu.vol.note.zh-TW: 主音量也包含發射時的聲音，不影響語音聊天。

ui.gmenu.view.note.en: In the facility you can also press Q to switch.
ui.gmenu.view.note.zh-TW: 在設施裡也可以按 Q 切換。

ui.gmenu.textsize.note.en: Applies to every menu, panel and label. Screens inside the facility keep their size.
ui.gmenu.textsize.note.zh-TW: 所有選單、面板和場景標籤都會一起變。設施裡牆上的螢幕維持原本大小。

ui.gmenu.quit.solo.en: This mission's progress won't be saved.

ui.gmenu.quit.tutorial.en: Training ends here. You can restart it from the main menu.
ui.gmenu.quit.tutorial.zh-TW: 訓練到這裡結束，之後可以從主選單重來。

ui.gmenu.quit.host.en: You're the host: the room closes and everyone goes back to the main menu.
ui.gmenu.quit.host.zh-TW: 你是房主：離開的話房間會關掉，所有人回到主選單。

ui.gmenu.quit.client.en: You will leave the room. The others can keep playing.
ui.gmenu.quit.client.zh-TW: 你會離開這個房間，其他人可以繼續玩。

ui.keys.use.zh-TW: 使用（設計主螢幕、線索、控制台）

ui.keys.install.en: Hold: install a part / fit a component
ui.keys.install.zh-TW: 長按：安裝零件／裝上小零件

err.poll_active.en: A Go/No-Go poll is running: the design is frozen until it ends.
err.poll_active.zh-TW: Go/No-Go 點名中：點名結束前設計不能改。

ui.restart.toast.en: Launch failed: back to part selection. Your filled-in values are kept.
ui.restart.toast.zh-TW: 發射失敗：回到選件重來。填過的數值還在。

err.host_only.en: Only the host can change that.

err.need_players.en: Waiting for another player to join.

ui.launchp.poll_note.en: Go/No-Go poll: all {n} players must call GO.
ui.launchp.poll_note.zh-TW: Go/No-Go 點名：{n} 位玩家都要喊 GO。

ui.poll.frozen.en: The design is frozen during the poll. Any NO-GO holds the launch.
ui.poll.frozen.zh-TW: 點名期間設計鎖定。只要有人喊 NO-GO 就暫停發射。

ui.poll.hold.en: {name} called NO-GO. Find out why, fix it, then start a new poll at the launch button.
ui.poll.hold.zh-TW: {name} 喊了 NO-GO。問清楚哪裡不對，修好再到發射按鈕重新點名。

ui.launch.call.seco.en: Second engine cutoff. We are in a parking orbit.
ui.launch.call.seco.zh-TW: 二節關機，進入停泊軌道。

ui.launch.call.coast.zh-TW: 滑行中，等待下一次點火。

ui.launch.call.coast_deploy.en: Coasting in orbit, standing by for spacecraft separation.
ui.launch.call.coast_deploy.zh-TW: 入軌滑行中，準備衛星分離。

ui.launch.call.battery_swap.en: Battery hot-swap: the spent battery pack is jettisoned.
ui.launch.call.battery_swap.zh-TW: 電池熱切換：拋掉用完的電池組。

ui.launch.call.kick_sep.en: Kick stage separation. Coasting to apogee.
ui.launch.call.kick_sep.zh-TW: 踢昇級分離，滑行到遠地點。

ui.launch.call.kick_ignite.zh-TW: 踢昇級點火：把軌道修圓。

ui.launch.call.kick_cutoff.en: Kick stage cutoff. We are in the final orbit.
ui.launch.call.kick_cutoff.zh-TW: 踢昇級關機，進入最終軌道。

ui.launch.call.deploy_fixed.en: Spacecraft separation. Body-mounted solar cells are in the Sun.
ui.launch.call.deploy_fixed.zh-TW: 衛星分離，機身上的太陽能電池照到太陽，開始發電。

ui.launch.call.deploy_gto.en: Spacecraft separation in geosynchronous transfer orbit.
ui.launch.call.deploy_gto.zh-TW: 衛星在地球同步轉移軌道分離。

ui.launch.call.deploy_lunar.en: Spacecraft separation. On its way to the Moon.

ui.launch.call.tli.en: Second stage relight: trans-lunar injection burn.
ui.launch.call.tli.zh-TW: 二節再次點火：地月轉移點火。

ui.launch.call.tli_done.en: Engine cutoff. Trans-lunar injection complete: we have left Earth orbit.
ui.launch.call.tli_done.zh-TW: 引擎關機，地月轉移點火完成：已經離開地球軌道。

ui.launch.call.lunar_coast.en: Trans-lunar coast: the spacecraft and the Moon circle Earth in the same direction (prograde) and meet in about five days
ui.launch.call.lunar_coast.zh-TW: 地月轉移滑行：衛星和月球同方向繞地球（順行），大約五天後會合

ui.launch.call.loi.en: Arriving at the Moon. Lunar orbit insertion: the engine fires for about 40 minutes to slow down.
ui.launch.call.loi.zh-TW: 抵達月球。月球軌道進入點火：引擎要燒大約 40 分鐘減速。

ui.launch.call.capture.en: Engine cutoff. Captured by the Moon's gravity. Trim burns over the next days lower it to the 100 km mapping orbit.
ui.launch.call.capture.zh-TW: 引擎關機，被月球重力捕獲。接下來幾天再做幾次修正點火，降到 100 公里的測繪軌道。

objective.wildfire.en: spotting new wildfires and alerting the fire service in time
objective.wildfire.zh-TW: 及早發現新起火點，並及時通報消防單位

event.diag.big_fire.en: The fire detector's hot-pixel count jumps and the data volume rises. The long-wave thermal reading rises with it.
event.diag.big_fire.zh-TW: 火點儀的熱點像素暴增、資料量上升，長波熱紅外線讀數也跟著升高。

event.diag.false_fire.en: Looks like a big fire on the fire detector, but the long-wave thermal reading stays flat, and the spot is in a desert or at a sun-glint angle. Without a thermal imager you cannot tell.
event.diag.false_fire.zh-TW: 火點儀看起來和大火爆發一樣，但長波熱紅外線沒有跟著升高，地點在沙漠或太陽反光角。沒裝長波熱紅外線就分不出來。

event.fire.reported.en: Procedure complete: the fire data went down first and the fire service had it in time.
event.fire.reported.zh-TW: 處置完成：火點資料優先下傳，消防單位及時收到通報。

event.fire.partial.en: Only part of the procedure was done: some of the fire data reached the ground late.
event.fire.partial.zh-TW: 處置只做了一部分：有些火點資料晚了才落地。

event.fire.stuck.en: The fire data waited in the queue on board; the alerts this turn arrived late.
event.fire.stuck.zh-TW: 火點資料卡在船上排隊，這回合的通報都晚了。

event.false_fire.reported.en: A false alarm was sent to the fire service. Crews were dispatched to a sun-baked desert.
event.false_fire.reported.zh-TW: 誤報送到了消防單位，消防隊被派到一片曬熱的沙漠。

event.false_fire.flagged.en: Marked as a false alarm: nothing was reported.
event.false_fire.flagged.zh-TW: 標記為誤報，沒有通報出去。

event.false_fire.ignored.en: Nothing was reported, but the false hot spot was never marked.
event.false_fire.ignored.zh-TW: 沒有通報，但這個假熱點也沒被標記。

warn.latency.en: Fire alerts too slow: {latency:0} min from sighting to the fire service (limit {limit:0} min). Waiting for a pass {wait:0} min, downlink {downlink:0.0} min, ground 5 min.
warn.latency.zh-TW: 火點通報太慢：從看到火點到通知消防單位要 {latency:0} 分鐘（時限 {limit:0} 分鐘）。等過站 {wait:0} 分、下傳 {downlink:0.0} 分、地面處理 5 分。

err.rideshare_orbit.en: A rideshare only goes to the main payload's orbit.
err.rideshare_orbit.zh-TW: 共乘只能去主酬載的軌道。

cause.gs_wait.en: With {stations} ground station(s), a fire waits about {wait} min for the next pass.
cause.gs_wait.zh-TW: 只有 {stations} 座地面站，看到火點後平均要等 {wait} 分鐘才過站。

cause.latency_total.en: Alert delay {min} min (downlink {downlink} min with {part}), over the {limit}-minute limit.
cause.latency_total.zh-TW: 通報延遲 {min} 分鐘（{part} 下傳 {downlink} 分鐘），超過 {limit} 分鐘的時限。

cause.timely.en: Only {pct}% of fires were reported in time.
cause.timely.zh-TW: 只有 {pct}% 的火點及時通報。

cause.no_fire_detector.en: No mid-wave infrared fire detector on board.
cause.no_fire_detector.zh-TW: 船上沒有中波紅外線火點儀。

cause.pass_time.en: {orbit} passes over at dawn and dusk.

cause.fire_weak.zh-TW: 那時候火勢小，偵測率只剩 {pct}%。

cause.fire_stuck.en: The fire data waited on board and the alerts went out late.
cause.fire_stuck.zh-TW: 火點資料卡在船上，通報晚了。

cause.lwir_flat.en: The long-wave thermal reading did not rise: it was not a fire.
cause.lwir_flat.zh-TW: 長波熱紅外線沒有升高：那不是火。

cause.no_lwir.en: With no long-wave thermal imager, there was no way to check it.
cause.no_lwir.zh-TW: 沒裝長波熱紅外線，沒辦法確認。

cause.false_reported.en: It was reported anyway, and the fire service trusts the satellite less.
cause.false_reported.zh-TW: 還是通報了出去，消防單位對衛星的信任又少了一點。

suggest.latency.en: More ground stations shorten the wait for a pass; a faster antenna shortens the downlink.
suggest.latency.zh-TW: 地面站多，等過站的時間短；天線快，下傳的時間短。

suggest.fire_detector.en: Fly the instrument that finds fires: the mid-wave infrared fire detector (P-7).
suggest.fire_detector.zh-TW: 裝上找得到火點的儀器：中波紅外線火點儀（P-7）。

suggest.pass_time.en: Fires burn hottest in the afternoon: pick the afternoon orbit, then check that the battery lasts through its shadow.
suggest.pass_time.zh-TW: 火勢在下午最旺：選下午過境的軌道，再確認電池撐得過那條軌道的地影。

suggest.fire_procedure.en: When the fire detector surges and the thermal reading rises too, send the fire data first and add downlinks.
suggest.fire_procedure.zh-TW: 火點儀暴增、長波熱紅外線也跟著升高時，火點優先下傳，再增加下傳。

suggest.false_fire.en: When the fire detector surges but the thermal reading stays flat, mark it as a false alarm and do not downlink it.
suggest.false_fire.zh-TW: 火點儀暴增、長波熱紅外線卻沒動時，標記為誤報，不要下傳。

ui.manual.rule.fire.en: A flame (~800 K) is brightest near 4 µm, so a mid-wave infrared fire detector (P-7) sees it. Detection = detector rate (P-7 60%; adding P-3 gives 5% more) × pass-time factor (13:30 ×1.0, dawn-dusk ×0.6: fires are small at dawn and dusk).
ui.manual.rule.fire.zh-TW: 火焰大約 800 K，在 4 微米附近最亮，所以要用中波紅外線火點儀（P-7）。偵測率 = 儀器偵測率（P-7 60%，加裝 P-3 再加 5%）× 過境時段係數（下午 13:30 ×1.0；晨昏 ×0.6，清晨傍晚火勢小）。

ui.manual.rule.latency.en: Delay = wait for a pass + downlink one orbit's data + 5 min on the ground. Wait = 24 h ÷ passes per day ÷ 2 (11 passes per station per day: 1 station 65 min, 3 stations 22 min, 6 stations 11 min). Downlink = (data per day ÷ 14.6 orbits) ÷ antenna rate. The limit is 30 min.
ui.manual.rule.latency.zh-TW: 延遲 = 等過站 + 下傳這一圈的資料 + 地面處理 5 分鐘。等過站 = 24 小時 ÷ 每天過站次數 ÷ 2（每座站每天 11 次：1 座 65 分、3 座 22 分、6 座 11 分）。下傳 = （每天資料 ÷ 14.6 圈）÷ 天線速率。時限 30 分鐘。

ui.manual.rule.falsefire.en: Sun-baked desert and sun glint can light up the fire detector too. A real fire also heats up the long-wave thermal band (P-3); a false one does not. Without P-3 the thermal reading shows NO DATA.
ui.manual.rule.falsefire.zh-TW: 沙漠被曬熱、太陽反光也會讓火點儀亮起來。真的火會讓長波熱紅外線（P-3）也跟著升高，假火點不會。沒裝 P-3 時長波讀數顯示「無資料」。

ui.brief.speech.wildfire.en:
Last year, several wildfires burned for hours before anyone on the ground noticed.
I want a satellite that [[spots wildfires while they are still small]] and tells the fire service [[within 30 minutes]].
I'm Chou, your flight director. The design is yours.
ui.brief.speech.wildfire.zh-TW:
去年有好幾場野火，燒了幾個小時地面才發現。
我要一顆衛星，在野火[[剛燒起來時就發現]]，[[30 分鐘內]]通知消防單位。
我是飛行主任周以安。設計交給你們了。

ui.launchp.funds_short.en: Operations money runs out after {funded} of {years} years: the mission will end early.
ui.launchp.funds_short.zh-TW: 營運經費只撐 {funded}／{years} 年：任務會提前結束。

ui.launchp.restart_note.en: If the launch fails you go back to part selection. Filled-in values and the builds you have learned are kept.
ui.launchp.restart_note.zh-TW: 發射失敗就回到選件重來：填過的數值、學會的組裝會留著。

ui.manual.quick_hint.en: Work it out here before you choose.

ui.manual.q.battery.en: Battery needed per 10 W in shadow
ui.manual.q.battery.zh-TW: 地影中每 10 W 負載需要的電池

cause.success_latency.en: Fires reached the fire service in {min} min, inside the {limit}-minute limit.
cause.success_latency.zh-TW: 火點 {min} 分鐘就通報到消防單位，在 {limit} 分鐘的時限內。

suggest.fire_tradeoff.en: Next step: adding the long-wave thermal imager (P-3) rules out false fires and finds a few more, but costs mass and power. Whether it pays off depends on the difficulty and the budget.
suggest.fire_tradeoff.zh-TW: 下一步：加裝長波熱紅外線（P-3）能排除假火點、多找到一些火點，但更重、更耗電。值不值得，看難度和預算。

ui.lobby.hint.en: Press E at a button to ready up
ui.lobby.hint.zh-TW: 到按鈕前按 E 準備

ui.lobby.hint_alone.en: Waiting for other players to join…

ui.lobby.hint_ready.zh-TW: 已準備 ✔ · 再按一次取消

ui.lobby.hint_host.en: All ready · press Enter to start
ui.lobby.hint_host.zh-TW: 全員就緒 · 按 Enter 開始

ui.lobby.hint_wait.en: All ready · waiting for the host
ui.lobby.hint_wait.zh-TW: 全員就緒 · 等房主開始

mini.fire_scan.goal.en: Send the fire data to the ground station
mini.fire_scan.goal.zh-TW: 把火點資料送進下傳站

mini.fire_scan.link.en: A satellite sees far more data than it can send down. Fire detections go first so crews can be alerted early; clouds and noise can wait.
mini.fire_scan.link.zh-TW: 衛星拍到的資料遠比能下傳的多。火點先送，消防隊才來得及出動；雲和雜訊晚點再說。

mini.fire_verify.goal.en: Find the cells that pass the line in both images
mini.fire_verify.goal.zh-TW: 找出兩張圖都過線的格子

mini.fire_verify.link.en: A hot spot in one channel can be sun-baked desert or sun glint. Check a second channel: only when both rise is it a real fire. False alarms waste firefighters' time and trust.
mini.fire_verify.link.zh-TW: 單一頻道的熱點可能只是曬熱的沙漠或太陽反光。看第二個頻道，兩個都升高才是真火。誤報浪費消防人力，也消耗信任。

mini.power_load.goal.en: Connect the solar panel to the battery
mini.power_load.goal.zh-TW: 把電線從太陽能板接到電池

mini.power_load.controls.en: Click a tile to turn it

mini.power_load.link.en: Solar output dropped, so power gets re-routed to the battery.
mini.power_load.link.zh-TW: 太陽能板發電變少，把電重新接到電池。

mini.rewire.goal.en: Find the fault, switch to backup, time it right
mini.rewire.goal.zh-TW: 找出故障、接上備援、對準時機

mini.rewire.link.en: A failed part is isolated first, then backup takes over or it is rebooted, then observations are rescheduled. Parts with a twin can take over by themselves.
mini.rewire.link.zh-TW: 零件故障時，先隔離，再切到備援或重開機，最後重排觀測。有備援的零件，壞了會自動接手。

mini.solar_dodge.goal.en: Last 26 seconds without losing all hull
mini.solar_dodge.goal.zh-TW: 撐過 26 秒，血量別歸零

mini.solar_dodge.link.en: Solar storm protons can fry electronics. The actual fix is safe mode, instruments off and facing the Sun; better shielding helps too.
mini.solar_dodge.link.zh-TW: 太陽風暴的高能粒子會打壞電子零件。實際的處置是進安全模式、關儀器、對日；護盾好一點也比較耐打。

mini.track_lock.goal.en: Keep the crosshair on the target for 60% of 20 seconds
mini.track_lock.goal.zh-TW: 20 秒內讓準星停在目標上，達 60%

mini.track_lock.link.en: A brief science opportunity is caught only if attitude control keeps the instrument on target. Steadier pointing, better odds; only a capture earns bonus science.
mini.track_lock.link.zh-TW: 短暫的科學機會，要靠姿態控制把儀器對準目標才拍得到。指向越穩越好拍，拍到才有額外科學分。

mini.alien.goal.en: Shoot down 60% of the intruders without losing all hull
mini.alien.goal.zh-TW: 擊落 60% 入侵者，機身別歸零

mini.alien.controls.en: WASD / arrow keys to move, auto-fire

mini.alien.link.en: Nobody has met aliens in orbit, but spacecraft dodge debris and surprises all the time. Better shielding means more hits survived.
mini.alien.link.zh-TW: 目前沒人在軌道上遇過外星人。不過太空船常要閃碎片和各種意外，護盾越好，撐得越久。

event.alien.repelled.en: The intruders were driven off. The contact log counts as bonus science.
event.alien.repelled.zh-TW: 入侵者被擊退，這次接觸的紀錄算額外科學成果。

event.alien.damaged.en: The intruders hit {part}: it lost half its output.
event.alien.damaged.zh-TW: 入侵者打壞了{part}：輸出只剩一半。

event.alien.ok.en: The intruders left on their own after a scare. Two observing days lost.
event.alien.ok.zh-TW: 入侵者嚇了一跳後自己走了，損失兩天觀測。

mini.none.en: Nothing to treat yet. Judge the event at the flight director desk first.
mini.none.zh-TW: 目前沒有要處置的事。先到飛行總監台判斷事件。

mini.resolved.en: This turn has already been resolved.

mini.to_desk.en: Back to the flight director desk

mini.rule.solo.en: Pass this to complete the whole procedure.
mini.rule.solo.zh-TW: 過關就算完成整套處置。

mini.rule.ratio.en: Team rule: at least {need} of {n} players must pass.
mini.rule.ratio.zh-TW: 全隊規則：{n} 人裡至少 {need} 人通關才算過。

mini.rule.sum.en: Team rule: the average score of all players must reach {pct}%.
mini.rule.sum.zh-TW: 全隊規則：所有人的平均分數要達到 {pct}%。

mini.no_retry.en: One try only. Fail and there's no treatment this turn.
mini.no_retry.zh-TW: 只能打一次。沒過，這回合就沒處置。

mini.team_note.en: Your score goes to the team. The team result comes when everyone is done.
mini.team_note.zh-TW: 成績會算進全隊，等所有人打完才出結果。

mini.pass_note.en: Procedure steps complete, if you judged the event correctly.
mini.pass_note.zh-TW: 事件判斷對的話，處置步驟全部完成。

mini.fail_note.en: No procedure steps done. Expect damage.
mini.fail_note.zh-TW: 處置步驟一個都沒做到，會有損失。

mini.debug.hint.en: Jump straight into any ops minigame. Nothing here affects the mission.
mini.debug.hint.zh-TW: 直接進任一個營運小遊戲測試，不影響任務。

ui.ops.treat_wait_judge.en: Judge the event first. The treatment follows your call.
ui.ops.treat_wait_judge.zh-TW: 先判斷事件。判斷是什麼事，就做什麼處置。

ui.ops.console_mini.en: Know what happened? Treat it at the flight director desk.
ui.ops.console_mini.zh-TW: 判斷完發生什麼事，到飛行總監台處置。

ui.ops.mini_wrong_game.en: You played {g}, but that is not what happened. Its steps do not fit.
ui.ops.mini_wrong_game.zh-TW: 你打了「{g}」，但發生的不是這件事，步驟對不上。

mini.fire_verify.cap.rule.en: Real fire shows up past the line in both images

mini.rewire.cap.3.en: Click when the cursor is in the green

mini.fire_verify.cap.fail.en: Too many false alarms or misses

mini.power_load.hint.line.en: Red dot = leak. Cracked tiles: go around
mini.power_load.hint.line.zh-TW: 紅點是漏電，裂開的方塊要繞過去

mini.power_load.cap.start.en: Connect the panel to the battery
mini.power_load.cap.start.zh-TW: 把電線從太陽能板接到電池

err.sandbox_only.en: Saved designs can only be loaded in the sandbox.
err.sandbox_only.zh-TW: 只有沙盒模式可以直接載入設計。

err.code_format.en: That is not a design code. It starts with GNG1- and must be pasted whole.
err.code_format.zh-TW: 這不是分享碼。分享碼開頭是 GNG1-，要整段貼上。

err.code_checksum.en: The design code has a typo. Copy it again.
err.code_checksum.zh-TW: 分享碼有錯字，重新複製一次。

err.code_unknown.en: This design uses a part, orbit or rocket this version does not have.
err.code_unknown.zh-TW: 這份設計用到這個版本沒有的零件、軌道或火箭。

objective.open.en: anything you like: every instrument is scored on what it does best
objective.open.zh-TW: 自由發揮：每台儀器都照它最擅長的任務算分

ui.brief.speech.sandbox.en:
This is the sandbox. I'm Flight Director Chou.
No [[budget cap]], no [[mission requirements]]. Every part, orbit and rocket is open.
Build it, launch it. Physics will tell you how it went.
ui.brief.speech.sandbox.zh-TW:
這裡是沙盒，我是飛行主任周以安。
[[沒有預算上限]]，也[[沒有任務需求]]。零件、軌道、火箭隨你挑。
組好就射上去，飛不飛得起來，物理會告訴你。

ui.asm.wrong.en: ✘ {name} isn't part of this one. Scrapped. It does: {role}
ui.asm.wrong.zh-TW: ✘ {name}不是這個零件的，報廢了。它負責：{role}

ui.codex.how.en: Build a part at a bench or install it on the satellite to earn its card. Build it [[without a single wrong fit]] and the card is [[★ mastered]].
ui.codex.how.zh-TW: 在組裝台組好零件，或把零件裝上衛星，就會拿到卡片。[[一次都沒裝錯]]的話，卡片升級成 [[★ 精通]]。

ui.codex.locked.en: Not collected. Build or install this part in a mission.
ui.codex.locked.zh-TW: 還沒拿到。在任務裡組裝或安裝這個零件就有。

ui.designs.intro.en: Save designs, share them as a code, compare them, or open one in the sandbox.
ui.designs.intro.zh-TW: 存下設計，用分享碼傳給朋友，或並排比較。也能在沙盒打開來改。

ui.designs.paste_failed.en: Can't read the clipboard. Click the box and press Ctrl+V (Cmd+V on Mac).
ui.designs.paste_failed.zh-TW: 讀不到剪貼簿。點輸入框，按 Ctrl+V（Mac 按 Cmd+V）貼上。

ui.designs.empty.en: Nothing saved yet. Save during a mission or on the report screen, or import a friend's code.
ui.designs.empty.zh-TW: 還沒有設計。在任務中或報告頁儲存，或匯入朋友的分享碼。

ui.designs.compare_hint.en: Tick Compare on two or three designs to see them side by side.
ui.designs.compare_hint.zh-TW: 勾兩到三份設計的「比較」，並排來看。

ui.designs.compare_hint_mission.en: Tick Compare on the current design and a saved one to see the difference.
ui.designs.compare_hint_mission.zh-TW: 勾「目前的設計」和一份存過的，看差在哪。

ui.designs.best_note.en: ★ marks the best design on each row. Red means over the limit.
ui.designs.best_note.zh-TW: ★ 是這一列最好的設計。紅色代表超出上限。

ui.menu.sandbox_desc.en: No budget cap, no requirements. Every part, orbit and rocket is open.
ui.menu.sandbox_desc.zh-TW: 沒有預算上限、沒有任務需求。所有零件、軌道、火箭都開放。

ui.menu.designs_desc.en: Save, share and compare your mission designs.
ui.menu.designs_desc.zh-TW: 儲存、分享、比較你的任務設計。

ui.menu.codex_desc.en: The knowledge cards you have collected by building and installing parts.
ui.menu.codex_desc.zh-TW: 組裝、安裝零件時收集到的知識卡。

ui.report.shared.en: Share code copied. Friends can import it in the design library.
ui.report.shared.zh-TW: 分享碼已複製。朋友在設計圖庫匯入就能拿到這份設計。

ui.keys.designs.zh-TW: 設計圖庫（儲存、分享、比較）

ui.brief.close_sandbox.en: Press L for the [[design library]] to save, share and compare builds. Have fun.
ui.brief.close_sandbox.zh-TW: 按 [[L]] 開[[設計圖庫]]，存檔、分享、比較都在那裡。玩得開心。

ui.brief.todo_sandbox.en: Tick anything on the [[design board]] and it goes straight onto the satellite. Then [[launch]]. Press [[L]] to load a saved design.
ui.brief.todo_sandbox.zh-TW: 在[[設計主螢幕]]隨便選，選了就直接裝上衛星，接著[[發射]]。按 [[L]] 載入存過的設計。

ui.tut.assemble.en: The [[build order]] on the bench screen says [[what the next component does]]. Pick the right one from the left with [[C]], then [[hold V]] on the [[right side]]. Wrong fits cost nothing.
ui.tut.assemble.zh-TW: 組裝台螢幕上的[[組裝單]]寫著下一個小零件[[是做什麼的]]。從左側按 [[C]] 拿起對的那個，到[[右側]][[長按 V]] 裝上。裝錯沒有懲罰。

ui.prog.goals_sandbox.en: Sandbox: no mission requirements. Build whatever you like.
ui.prog.goals_sandbox.zh-TW: 沙盒沒有任務需求，自由發揮。

ui.report.first_free.en: Sandbox: failed launches do not count, bonus kept
ui.report.first_free.zh-TW: 沙盒：發射失敗不算，加分照給

ui.launchp.sandbox_note.en: Sandbox: a failed launch costs nothing. The design stays on the stand.
ui.launchp.sandbox_note.zh-TW: 沙盒：發射失敗沒有代價，設計會留在整合台上。

err.bench_busy.en: This bench is building another part: finish it, or use the other bench.
err.bench_busy.zh-TW: 這座組裝台正在組另一個零件：先組完，或用另一座。

err.no_job.en: Put the components on the left side of the bench first, so it can recognise the part.
err.no_job.zh-TW: 先把小零件放到組裝台左側，才認得出要組哪個零件。

err.comp_gone.en: That component is no longer on the bench.
err.comp_gone.zh-TW: 這個小零件已經不在組裝台上了。

ui.hint.holding_comp.en: Carry it to a bench and press E to put it on the left side
ui.hint.holding_comp.zh-TW: 拿到組裝台，按 E 放到左側

ui.bench.idle.en: Put components on the left side.

ui.bench.step.en: Step {n} of {total}: the small part to fit
ui.bench.step.zh-TW: 第 {n}／{total} 步：要裝的小零件

ui.bench.fetch.en: Pick the matching one from the left side
ui.bench.fetch.zh-TW: 從左側拿起符合說明的那一個

ui.bench.done.en: {code} is built. Take it to the integration stand.
ui.bench.done.zh-TW: {code} 組好了，拿去整合台安裝。

ui.asm.howto.en: Pick the matching component from the [[left side]] with [[C]] · [[hold V]] on the [[right side]] to fit it
ui.asm.howto.zh-TW: 從[[左側]]按 [[C]] 拿起符合說明的小零件 · 在[[右側]][[長按 V]] 裝上

ui.asm.take.en: Built! Pick it up with [[C]] and take it to the stand
ui.asm.take.zh-TW: 組好了！按 [[C]] 拿起來，帶去整合台

ui.asm.wrong_order.en: ✘ Not {name} yet: it went back to the left side. It does: {role}
ui.asm.wrong_order.zh-TW: ✘ 還沒輪到{name}，放回左側了。它負責：{role}

ui.asm.built.en: {code} built. Its knowledge card is in your collection (K).
ui.asm.built.zh-TW: {code} 組好了！知識卡收進圖鑑（按 K 看）

ui.asm.built_flawless.en: {code} built without a single wrong fit: knowledge card ★ mastered
ui.asm.built_flawless.zh-TW: {code} 零失誤組好：知識卡升級 ★ 精通

ui.codex.master_tag.en: ★ MASTERED · built with no wrong fit
ui.codex.master_tag.zh-TW: ★ 精通 · 組裝時一次都沒裝錯

ui.codex.master_how.en: Build this structure with no wrong fit and the card becomes ★ mastered.
ui.codex.master_how.zh-TW: 組這種構造時一次都沒裝錯，卡片就升級成 ★ 精通。

ui.report.assembly_clean.en: Not one wrong fit at the bench

ui.tut.bench.en: Carry them to the [[bench]] and press [[E]] to put them on the [[left side]]. With the full set, the bench recognises the part.
ui.tut.bench.zh-TW: 把小零件拿到[[組裝台]]，按 [[E]] 放到[[左側]]。放齊了就會認出是哪個零件。

ui.guide.fit.en: Read the [[build order]]: pick the component that matches the description from the left with [[C]], then [[hold V]] on the right. Wrong fits cost nothing.
ui.guide.fit.zh-TW: 看[[組裝單]]：從左側按 [[C]] 拿起符合說明的小零件，到右側[[長按 V]] 裝上。裝錯沒有懲罰。

ui.guide.take.en: It is built. Pick it up at the bench with [[C]] and take it to the [[integration stand]].
ui.guide.take.zh-TW: 組好了。到組裝台按 [[C]] 拿起來，帶去[[整合台]]。

ui.brief.again.en: Forgot something? Press [[B]] any time to read this again.
ui.brief.again.zh-TW: 忘了要做什麼，隨時按 [[B]] 重看任務說明。

ui.bench.sandbox.en: No assembly in the sandbox: ticked parts go straight onto the satellite.
ui.bench.sandbox.zh-TW: 沙盒不用組裝：零件選了就直接裝上衛星。

err.bench_full.en: The left side is full (6). Take away what you don't need.
err.bench_full.zh-TW: 左側放滿了（6 個）。先拿走用不到的。

err.bench_take_first.en: Pick up the finished part first.

err.carry_part.en: A finished part can't be put down: take it to the stand and install it.
err.carry_part.zh-TW: 組好的零件不能放下：拿到整合台裝上衛星。

err.comp_dup.en: You already have one of these. One is enough.
err.comp_dup.zh-TW: 這種小零件你已經拿了，一種一個就夠。

err.confirmed.en: The design is confirmed. Reopen it on the design board to change it.
err.confirmed.zh-TW: 設計已確定。要改先到設計主螢幕按「重新開啟設計」。

err.design_incomplete.en: The design is incomplete: pick one in every category.
err.design_incomplete.zh-TW: 設計還沒選齊：每一類都要選一個。

err.not_blank.en: This value doesn't need filling in.

err.not_confirmed.en: Confirm the design on the design board first.
err.not_confirmed.zh-TW: 先在設計主螢幕確定設計。

err.not_installed.en: Some parts are not installed on the satellite yet.

err.sandbox_no_assembly.en: No assembly in the sandbox: ticked parts go straight onto the satellite.
err.sandbox_no_assembly.zh-TW: 沙盒不用組裝：零件選了就直接裝上衛星。

err.single_required.en: This category needs one part: tick another one to swap.
err.single_required.zh-TW: 這一類必選一個。要換就直接點另一個。

err.minigame.en: That is not the procedure for this event.
err.minigame.zh-TW: 這不是現在要做的處置。

ui.brief.todo_team.en: Tick parts on the [[design board]] up front. Blank values hide in [[clues]]: split up and [[tell each other]] what you find.
ui.brief.todo_team.zh-TW: 到前方的[[設計主螢幕]]選零件。空白的數值藏在[[線索]]裡：分頭找，[[用講的]]告訴隊友。

ui.brief.close_team.en: The requirements are listed on the [[design board]]. A clue is [[visible only to whoever zooms in]]: say what you find. Good luck.
ui.brief.close_team.zh-TW: 需求都列在[[設計主螢幕]]上。線索[[只有放大的人看得到]]：找到就說出來。祝順利。

ui.keys.run_toggle.en: Run / walk (press once to keep running, again to walk)
ui.keys.run_toggle.zh-TW: 跑／走（按一下一直跑，再按一下改回走）

ui.gmenu.vol.voice_off.en: Voice chat not connected. It only works in co-op rooms joined with a room code.
ui.gmenu.vol.voice_off.zh-TW: 語音沒連上。用房間碼加入的多人房間才有語音。

ui.gmenu.run.note.en: Toggle: press once to keep running, again to walk.
ui.gmenu.run.note.zh-TW: 切換模式：按一下一直跑，再按一下改回走。

ui.launchp.need_confirm.en: The design is not confirmed: confirm it on the design board.
ui.launchp.need_confirm.zh-TW: 設計還沒確定：到設計主螢幕按「確定設計」。

ui.launchp.need_install.en: {n} part(s) not installed on the satellite: {list}
ui.launchp.need_install.zh-TW: 還有 {n} 個零件沒裝上衛星：{list}

ui.launchp.over_budget.en: Over budget by {over}: pick cheaper parts or a cheaper rocket, or plan fewer years.
ui.launchp.over_budget.zh-TW: 超出預算 {over}：換便宜的零件或火箭，或減少營運年數。

ui.launchp.ready.en: Every part is installed and the budget holds: ready to launch.
ui.launchp.ready.zh-TW: 零件都裝好了，預算也夠：可以發射。

ui.fac.stand_left.zh-TW: 還有 {n} 個零件沒裝上

ui.fac.bay_body.en: Which components each part needs, and how far along it is.
ui.fac.bay_body.zh-TW: 每個零件要用哪些小零件、組到哪裡了。

ui.fac.select_body.en: Tick parts, enter values, read the dashboard, then confirm the design.
ui.fac.select_body.zh-TW: 選零件、填數值、看儀表板，然後確定設計。

ui.hint.carry_part.en: You are carrying a finished part

ui.lobby.board.select.body.en: Tick parts on the design board in the control room. Blank values are in clues around both rooms.
ui.lobby.board.select.body.zh-TW: 在中控室的設計主螢幕選零件。空白的數值去找線索，兩個房間都有。

ui.lobby.board.assemble.body.en: After confirming the design, head to the bay: components from the shelves → build at a bench → install on the satellite → launch from the control room.
ui.lobby.board.assemble.body.zh-TW: 設計確定後到組裝區：架上拿小零件 → 組裝台組好 → 裝上衛星 → 回中控室發射。

ui.asm.howto_left.en: Take components from the [[shelves]] with [[C]] · put them on the left side with [[E]]
ui.asm.howto_left.zh-TW: 到[[小零件架]]按 [[C]] 拿 · 回來按 [[E]] 放到左側

ui.asm.recognised.en: Recognised: {code} {name}. Fit the components in the order shown.
ui.asm.recognised.zh-TW: 認出來了：{code} {name}。照提示依序裝上。

ui.bench.not_in_design.en: Not a part of this design.

ui.bench.waiting.en: Waiting for the design to be confirmed.

ui.bench.status.empty.en: The left side is empty. Put the components of one part here.
ui.bench.status.empty.zh-TW: 左側是空的。把一個零件要用的小零件放上來。

ui.bench.status.partial.en: Not recognised yet: these belong to a part, but some are missing.
ui.bench.status.partial.zh-TW: 還認不出來：是某個零件的小零件，但還缺幾個。

ui.bench.status.unknown.en: ✘ This set builds nothing. Take away what doesn't belong.
ui.bench.status.unknown.zh-TW: ✘ 這個組合組不出任何零件。把放錯的拿走。

ui.bench.status.notindesign.en: ✘ That is not a part of this design (or it is already built).
ui.bench.status.notindesign.zh-TW: ✘ 這不是這次設計的零件（或已經組過了）。

ui.bench.status.waiting.en: Waiting for the control room to confirm the design.

ui.bench.status.active.en: Recognised: fit the components in the order shown.
ui.bench.status.active.zh-TW: 認出來了：照提示依序裝上。

ui.bench.status.done.en: Built: take it to the stand and install it.
ui.bench.status.done.zh-TW: 組好了：拿去整合台裝上衛星。

ui.bay.waiting.en: WAITING FOR THE CONTROL ROOM TO CONFIRM THE DESIGN

ui.bay.waiting_body.en: Once the design is confirmed, this board lists the components each part needs.
ui.bay.waiting_body.zh-TW: 設計確定後，這裡會列出每個零件要用哪些小零件。

ui.sel.blank_hint.en: Blank values come from clues: {n} / {total} filled
ui.sel.blank_hint.zh-TW: 空白的數值要從線索找：已填 {n}／{total}

ui.sel.no_values.en: Nothing to fill in for this part
ui.sel.no_values.zh-TW: 這個零件沒有要填的數值

ui.sel.nan.zh-TW: 請輸入 0 到 9,999,999 的數字

ui.sel.desc_locked.en: {n} value(s) still blank: fill them in to see the full description
ui.sel.desc_locked.zh-TW: 還有 {n} 個數值沒填，填完才顯示完整說明

ui.sel.sandbox_note.en: Sandbox: ticked parts go straight onto the satellite. No clues, no assembly.
ui.sel.sandbox_note.zh-TW: 沙盒：勾選的零件直接裝上衛星，不用找數值、不用組裝。

ui.sel.confirm_note.en: Confirming lists each part's components in the bay. You can reopen the design later.
ui.sel.confirm_note.zh-TW: 確定後，組裝區才會列出每個零件要用的小零件。之後還能重新開啟。

ui.sel.confirmed_body.en: The bay can start building. Reopen to swap parts: only the swapped parts need rebuilding.
ui.sel.confirmed_body.zh-TW: 組裝區可以開始組裝了。要換零件就重新開啟：只有換掉的零件要重組。

ui.sel.confirmed_toast.en: Design confirmed: fetch components in the bay and start building
ui.sel.confirmed_toast.zh-TW: 設計已確定：到組裝區拿小零件開始組裝

ui.sel.all_installed.en: Every part is installed: go to the launch button
ui.sel.all_installed.zh-TW: 零件全裝上了，去按發射鈕

ui.dash.blank_note.en: {n} value(s) of the ticked parts are blank: anything that needs them shows "not enough data".
ui.dash.blank_note.zh-TW: 選的零件還有 {n} 個數值沒填：用到它們的項目先顯示「資料不足」。

ui.dash.cost_x.zh-TW: 開發 {dev} ＋ 火箭 {launch} ＋ 營運 {ops}

ui.req.tradeoff_note.en: TRADE-OFF requirements pull against each other. You pick which way to lean.
ui.req.tradeoff_note.zh-TW: 標「取捨」的需求互相牽制，偏哪一邊由你們決定。

ui.clue.look.en: Zoom in to see whether it holds a value you need.
ui.clue.look.zh-TW: 放大看看有沒有用得上的數值。

ui.clue.nothing.zh-TW: 這裡沒有用得上的數值。

ui.clue.chart.foot.en: Value = the mark at the end of each bar.
ui.clue.chart.foot.zh-TW: 數值看長條末端標的數字。

ui.clue.phrase.data_gb_per_day.en: it produces {v} GB of data a day
ui.clue.phrase.data_gb_per_day.zh-TW: 每天產生 {v} GB 資料

ui.clue.note.0.en: {part} passed acceptance testing today: {facts}. All within spec.
ui.clue.note.0.zh-TW: {part} 今天完成驗收測試：{facts}。全部在規格內。

ui.clue.note.1.en: Note to self: update the design sheet for {part}: {facts}.
ui.clue.note.1.zh-TW: 記得把 {part} 的新數字更新到設計表：{facts}。

ui.clue.note.2.en: The supplier confirmed the final numbers for {part}: {facts}.
ui.clue.note.2.zh-TW: 廠商確認了 {part} 的最終規格：{facts}。

ui.clue.note.3.en: For the next shift: {part} has been measured: {facts}.
ui.clue.note.3.zh-TW: 交接給下一班：{part} 已量測完畢，{facts}。

ui.clue.junk.paper.0.en: A lunch order: lunch boxes and iced tea.

ui.clue.junk.paper.1.en: Reminder: change gloves before entering the clean room.
ui.clue.junk.paper.1.zh-TW: 別忘了：進無塵室要換手套。

ui.clue.junk.paper.2.en: Meeting room sign-up sheet: Wednesday afternoon is full.
ui.clue.junk.paper.2.zh-TW: 會議室借用表：週三下午已滿。

ui.clue.junk.whiteboard.0.en: The shift rota. Days and nights are both covered.
ui.clue.junk.whiteboard.0.zh-TW: 值班表：早班、晚班都排好了。

ui.clue.junk.whiteboard.1.en: To do today: calibrate the scale, reply to the supplier, order coffee.
ui.clue.junk.whiteboard.1.zh-TW: 今日待辦：校正磅秤、回覆廠商、訂咖啡。

ui.clue.junk.whiteboard.2.en: Someone drew a cat riding a rocket. No numbers.
ui.clue.junk.whiteboard.2.zh-TW: 有人畫了一隻騎火箭的貓。沒有數字。

ui.clue.junk.blackboard.0.en: Kepler's third law: the higher the orbit, the longer one lap takes.
ui.clue.junk.blackboard.0.zh-TW: 克卜勒第三定律：軌道越高，繞一圈越久。

ui.clue.junk.blackboard.1.en: F = ma. Next to it: "This will be on the test."
ui.clue.junk.blackboard.1.zh-TW: F = ma。旁邊寫著：「考試會考」。

ui.clue.junk.blackboard.2.en: A half-erased equation. No telling what it was for.
ui.clue.junk.blackboard.2.zh-TW: 擦掉一半的算式，看不出在算什麼。

ui.clue.junk.book.0.en: A mission engineering textbook, chapter one: a mission starts from requirements, not from parts.
ui.clue.junk.book.0.zh-TW: 任務工程教科書第一章：任務從需求開始，不是從零件開始。

ui.clue.junk.book.1.en: An old novel with a bookmark in it.
ui.clue.junk.book.1.zh-TW: 一本舊小說，裡面夾著書籤。

ui.clue.junk.book.2.en: Staff handbook: walk through the air shower before entering the clean room.
ui.clue.junk.book.2.zh-TW: 員工手冊：進無塵室前先過風淋室。

ui.clue.junk.blueprint.1.zh-TW: 舊版設計圖，上面蓋著「作廢」。

ui.wall.howto.0.en: Find clues: scattered around both rooms (walls, boards, books, desks, the floor)
ui.wall.howto.0.zh-TW: 找線索：散落在兩個房間（牆上、板子、書、桌面、地上）

ui.wall.howto.1.en: Enter the values on the design board
ui.wall.howto.1.zh-TW: 把數值填進設計主螢幕

ui.wall.howto.2.en: Tick parts; check the dashboard and the requirements
ui.wall.howto.2.zh-TW: 選零件，看儀表板和任務需求

ui.wall.howto.4.en: Build the parts in the bay and install them
ui.wall.howto.4.zh-TW: 到組裝區組裝，裝上衛星

ui.guide.values.en: [[{n} value(s)]] of your ticked parts are blank. Zoom into [[clues]] to find them, then enter them on the design board.
ui.guide.values.zh-TW: 選的零件還有 [[{n} 個數值]]沒填。放大[[線索]]找出來，填進設計主螢幕。

ui.guide.confirm.en: The values are in and the requirements are met. Press [[Confirm design]] on the [[design board]].
ui.guide.confirm.zh-TW: 數值填好、需求也達成了。到[[設計主螢幕]]按[[確定設計]]。

ui.guide.fetch.en: {n} part(s) left to build. Start with [[{code}]]: take [[{list}]] from the [[shelves]].
ui.guide.fetch.zh-TW: 還有 {n} 個零件要組。先組 [[{code}]]：到[[小零件架]]拿[[{list}]]。

ui.guide.put.en: Carry the components to a [[bench]] and press [[E]] to put them on the left side. A complete set is recognised.
ui.guide.put.zh-TW: 把小零件拿到[[組裝台]]，按 [[E]] 放到左側。放齊了，系統就認得出是哪個零件。

ui.guide.budget.en: Everything is installed, but you are [[over budget]] and cannot launch. [[Reopen the design]] on the design board and pick cheaper parts or a cheaper rocket.
ui.guide.budget.zh-TW: 零件都裝好了，但[[超出預算]]不能發射。到設計主螢幕[[重新開啟設計]]，換便宜的零件或火箭。

ui.tut.clue.en: Some values are blank and hide in clues. Walk to the [[marker]], aim at it and press [[E]] to zoom in. Only you can see what it says.
ui.tut.clue.zh-TW: 有些數值被挖空了，藏在線索裡。走到[[標記的地方]]，對準它按 [[E]] 放大。內容只有你看得到。

ui.tut.fill.en: Aim at the [[design board]] up front and press [[E]]. Open [[SOLAR ARRAY]], find the blank on [[S-2]], type the [[mass]] you just read and press Enter.
ui.tut.fill.zh-TW: 對準前方的[[設計主螢幕]]按 [[E]]。切到[[太陽能板]]，找到 [[S-2]] 空白的那一格，輸入剛才看到的[[質量]]，按 Enter。

ui.tut.confirm.en: The parts are already ticked for you. Press [[Confirm design]] on the design board: only then does the bay list the components to use.
ui.tut.confirm.zh-TW: 零件已經幫你選好了。在設計主螢幕按[[確定設計]]，組裝區才會列出要用的小零件。

ui.tut.shelf.en: Go through the door to the [[assembly bay]]. The wall board lists the components S-2 needs: aim at each one on the [[shelves]] and press [[C]].
ui.tut.shelf.zh-TW: 穿過門到[[組裝區]]。牆上的儀表板列出 S-2 要用的小零件：到[[小零件架]]對準它們，按 [[C]] 拿。
